payload.core_mechanism_summary: Memoized recursion on states (u,v,min_char) with u and v as marble positions, min_char enforces non-decreasing edge letters. DP table stores winner; recursion alternates turns.
payload.rationale: Solution uses 3D DP (n×n×26) memoization. States: (u,v,min_char) for positions and min char. Transitions follow edges with non-decreasing char. Small third dimension (26) makes it like 2D DP with parameter. Recursive DP, not pure search.
